messages.author: 8ae1efaa2cf53fab
messages.subject: Re: Chromosome explorer - blue shades above ruler
parts:
Hi,

I would assume that the colour gradient relates to the Giemsa stain
results. See the track 'Chromosome Band' (under Mapping and
Sequencing tracks) on the UCSC Human Browser (http://
genome.ucsc.edu.au) for further details. The schema for the track
gives the values for the Giemsa stain.

cheers

Lavinia.
